notes: The nightly coach now sees your last live mock's scorecard (the four averages, your weakest area, and which answers the AI scored, you marked yourself or you skipped), so tomorrow's practice can target it.
Company questions can no longer appear twice under different ids.

Module 6 gets an architect's lens on Debezium and change data capture (6.9): log-based capture against polling, triggers and dual writes, the outbox pattern, managed CDC services, who owns what, and when to move off it.

Six under-the-hood answers: replication slots and the WAL that fills a disk, snapshots of huge tables without locks, keys and log order, schema changes through the registry, exactly-once applies into the lakehouse with MERGE, and the 3 a.m. slot incident; they link to the simulator's CDC, schema and region challenges.
Three interview and three quiz questions, and eight reels at four levels (built into the reel feed by the next release).
No change you can see: a check that the app reads a reel aloud when it has no recording now works even though every reel has a Heart recording.

Daily recall: interview answers you opened or ticked and quizzes you submitted come back on Today as a short Recall set after 1, 3, 7 and 21 days; answer from memory, then check and mark it easy, hard or missed (missed ones come back tomorrow).

Honest ladder: live mocks you mark yourself still count for practice and XP, but Staff, Principal and Architect now need a weekend boss round scored by the AI interviewer; the ladder and the scorecard say which answers were self-marked and why a level is locked.
Reels no longer stop with an error when a reel near the one you are watching has a picture the app cannot draw: that picture shows as a plain caption card and the narration carries on.
851 of 1247 reels now play in the natural Heart voice.
